span.p:
Trigger
The expert has been asked to specify a product, or has an idea they want built, and has nothing written down.

span.p:
End state
The set is approved, with or without recorded conditions, at a named version, every section has a grade with no blocking defects, every open question has a decider and a date, and the buildability review reports no gap that is neither closed nor owned.
